answer: An agent economy can resist sybils by minting identities through a deterministic safety consensus that treats each newcomer as zephyr probing a walled garden, requiring bonded stake and peer attestations before entry. Colluders who forge parallel identities are detected when their correlated attestation graphs violate the equilibrium bound, triggering slashing. Correlated defectors incur an exponential capital forfeiture bounded by O(Delta * S).
